content:
name: Publish

on:
  push:
    tags:
      - 'v*'

permissions:
  id-token: write
  contents: read

jobs:
  publish:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v7
        with:
          node-version: lts/*
          registry-url: https://registry.npmjs.org
      - run: npm ci
      - run: npm run lint
      - run: npm test
      - run: npm publish
